introduction.content_en: A dua is a personal prayer or supplication to Allah. Unlike salah which has a fixed structure, dua can be made at any time, in any language. However, the Prophet ﷺ taught us specific duas for different occasions. These are the most authentic ones for daily life.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
duas.translation: All praise is due to Allah, Who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
duas.translation: All praise is due to Allah Who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from me.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallahi wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might or power except with Allah.
O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.

duas.notes: Say this frequently throughout the day. The Prophet ﷺ used to seek forgiveness more than 70 times a day.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa Anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
duas.translation: There is no god but You, glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.notes: This is the dua of Prophet Yunus (Jonah) when he was in the belly of the whale.
